ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-green leafy greens, crisp curled and torn leaves with lighter ivory ribs, coated in a creamy pale dressing with visible light sheen; scattered small golden toasted cubes and grated pale cheese flecks; covers roughly 35% of the plate on the left side, about 14 cm tall mound | 110
ITEM 2 | Golden-brown cooked meat pieces, shredded and irregular chunks about 2 to 4 cm, with darker charred edges, slightly glossy and moist surface, some pale fibrous strands and a light tan sauce residue; sits on the right upper side of the plate, covering roughly 20% of the plate | 95
ITEM 3 | Two triangular wedges of pizza with bright red tomato sauce, pepperoni discs with slight curling and glossy orange grease, and melted pale yellow cheese with light browning; crust edge visible at bottom; sits at lower right, covering roughly 18% of the plate, about 2 cm thick | 150
ITEM 4 | Thin smear of light tan creamy sauce with glossy sheen along the right edge of the meat and near the top right of the plate, pooled in small streaks | 10
